points.statement: Reframes restoration as an autoregressive generation problem so spectral and spatial dependencies are modeled progressively rather than reconstructed globally.
points.quote: We break this impasse by introducing HSI-VAR, rethinking HSI restoration as an autoregressive generation problem, where spectral and spatial dependencies can be progressively modeled rather than globally reconstructed.

points.statement: Couples latent priors with conditional embeddings, encodes mixed degradations as linear combinations for guidance, and refines spatial and spectral details during decoding.
points.quote: HSI-VAR incorporates three key innovations: (1) Latent–condition alignment, which couples semantic consistency between latent priors and conditional embeddings for precise reconstruction; (2) Degradation-aware guidance, which uniquely encodes mixed degradations as linear combinations in the embedding space for automatic control, remarkably achieving a nearly 50% reduction in computational cost at inference; (3) A spatial–spectral adaptation module that refines details across both domains in the decoding phase.
